title: Prohibition of Benami transactions
text: (1) No person shall enter into any Benami transaction. (2) Whoever enters into any Benami transaction or abets the commission of a Benami transaction shall be guilty of the offence of Benami transaction.
source_file: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 2017
text_normalized: (1) No person shall enter into any Benami transaction. (2) Whoever enters into any Benami transaction or abets the commission of a Benami transaction shall be guilty of the offence of Benami transaction.

title: Property held in Benami liable to confiscation
text: Any property, which is subject-matter of a Benami transaction, shall be liable to be confiscated by the Federal Government.
source_file: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 2017
text_normalized: Any property, which is subject-matter of a Benami transaction, shall be liable to be confiscated by the Federal Government.
